title: Historiography atlas and History PhD citation graph
description: An interactive atlas of historiography and a citation graph of History PhD dissertations from Canada, the United States, Europe and elsewhere: which works each dissertation cites, with parsed author, title, year and kind. The dataset release is in data/field-research/dissertation-citations-2026-10-11/release/ (CSV files with a data dictionary, method, measured quality and provenance). It holds derived bibliographic metadata only; no text from the dissertations is included. Built with rule-based Python extraction from open repository PDFs.
